question: how much of the CSS and JS a Drupal page loads is used at load and after scrolling, how much of a new same-site aggregate repeats bytes the site already served, and how much of the document is markup a local copy would not need to resend
instrument: Chromium CDP CSS.takeCoverageDelta, Profiler.takePreciseCoverage, CSS.getStyleSheetText, Debugger.getScriptSource, Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength; Node zlib brotli 5 and zstd 3 (raw dictionary)

method.pages per site: home plus up to 8 internal pages
method.page choice: payload.ts: links from the rendered home page, pages with a JSON:API alias first, the rest spread evenly
method.order: home first, then the internal pages in choice order, one context and one page per site
method.coverage: CSS: CDP rule usage (takeCoverageDelta) at load and after scrolling, bytes of the rules used; JS: Profiler precise block coverage at load and after scrolling, bytes of the innermost range that ran, the scroll read (a delta, since each take resets the counts) added to the load read; same-origin and third-party files kept apart
method.coverage key: file URL with its query replaced by the parameter names
method.scroll: scroll one viewport at a time, up to 40 steps, stop when the page stops moving, wait 1000 ms, then read the used bytes again
method.unused bytes: raw bytes outside the used ranges at load, and brotli-5 of that unused text alone
method.churn: a file is reused when its full URL was requested on an earlier page of the site; new same-origin CSS and JS files are compressed alone and with a zstd 3 raw dictionary of the same-origin CSS and JS texts of earlier pages (last 1 MiB)
method.repeated share: 1 - (zstd 3 with dictionary) / (zstd 3 alone), summed over the new files of a page; brotli-5 is reported alone because Node brotli takes no dictionary
method.markup: document bytes; each class is the piece list (count, raw bytes, brotli-5 of the pieces together) and the marginal brotli-5 saving of removing it from the document
method.settings: top-level keys of drupal-settings-json; a key varies when its value hash differs across the site pages or it is absent from some page
method.transfer: encodedDataLength per finished request, bucketed by same or third origin, resource type and new or reused URL; requests still open at the end are counted as unfinished
method.request delay: 250 ms between page visits; the JSON:API probe uses the payload.ts delay
method.warm-internal table: from the repeat-nav requests reading; byType and thirdPartyBytes are all origins, same-origin by type is not in that reading
